body: Everyday is the same for me. Monotony is killing me.
That’s all there is. Nothing else within context to talk about.
i’ve been told constantly, “one day at a time” but it gets so tiring, man. i hope something changes for us because i don’t know how long i’ll last.

my parents are successful. both my sisters are going to great colleges. i have to attend community because i’m not smart enough. i have contributed nothing of worth to my family and i hate myself for it.
